text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian newspapers this morning.
- Every fourth patient at Oslo's Ullevaal hospital is unhappy with the place, saying rooms are small and not kept clean and that they have little contact with nurses and doctors.
- Brann Bergen rejects the bid from Everton, which is willing to pay 25 million crowns for Claus Eftevaag and Tore Andre Flo. The Norwegian soccer club wants a higher bid from the English club.
- Prime Minister Thorbjoern Jagland is spending the Easter holidays skiing around Kautokeino in north Norway.

- The whole world looks up to Norway. Norway is one of the happiest countries in the world. Norwegians are best at almost everything. We are leaders in terms of life quality, new technology and ability to adapt, an international study shows.

- Do Swedish cars belong in a museum? Volvo and Saab both are struggling with their image and sales figures. Will we find Swedish cars in the Norwegian mountains after the year 2000? Pessimists are already writing the epitaph of Sweden's last source of pride -- the car industry.
